Why most trading accounts blow up

It's almost never the strategy.

You're here because you've already tried a course, a signals group, hours of YouTube, and the account still went to zero. In our experience it comes down to three things, none of them the strategy:

  • Copying signals is not a plan. When the caller goes quiet, you've got nothing: no entry rule, no exit rule, no idea why you're even in the trade.
  • A bigger lot size doesn't fix a broken process. It just makes the same mistake cost more. Doubling down on a losing method only loses faster.
  • Random entries burn capital. Ten trades with no consistent setup isn't a strategy being tested. It's gambling with extra steps.

This workshop is about replacing all three with a written, repeatable process.

And no, this isn't a "quit your job, trade from the beach" pitch. The 8Con coaching team trades real accounts with real risk limits, and will show you the losing months too.

Questions

Before you register.

Is this onsite or online?

Onsite and live at 933 ABZ Building, Brgy. Calvario, MacArthur Highway, Meycauayan, Bulacan 3020. There's no replay for this one, being in the room is the point.

Do I need money to attend?

No. Bring zero pesos. You'll learn the mechanics first and practise on a free demo account before you ever risk real money.

Is this a signals or copy-trading group?

No. We teach you to make your own decisions. We don't sell signals and we don't manage anyone's money.

Will you pitch me something?

Near the end, the coaching team will walk you through what's next for people who want to go deeper. It's explained live and it's optional. The workshop stands on its own whether you join it or not.

Is digital trading legal and taxable in the Philippines?

Trading in the financial markets through a broker is not prohibited for individuals. Any profit is taxable income. We're educators, not tax, legal, or investment advisers.

How will I know when to attend?

After you register, someone from the 8Con team will call you to confirm a schedule that works for you. No date is locked in until that call.
